sourceChecks.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベナヤの父としてヨヤダの名が記され、本文はベナヤの出自と勇敢な行いを述べます。

sourceChecks.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベナヤの父としてヨヤダの名が記され、本文はベナヤの出自と勇敢な行いを述べます。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: この節ではヨヤダがアロンの家の指導者として記されます。

sourceChecks.text: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベナヤの父としてヨヤダの名が記され、本文はベナヤの出自と勇敢な行いを述べます。

sourceChecks.text: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ベナヤはヨヤダの子で「祭司長」と記されます。
